deep.reconstruction:
The page holds two unrelated pieces: a short number-theory fragment at the top left, and preparatory computations for Riemann's 1861 memoir on the motion of a homogeneous fluid ellipsoid (the rest of the page and the bundle).

(A) NUMBER THEORY (top left; the archival label 'Riemann 20' is not his).
- Start from Riemann's 1859 formula f(x) = (1/2πi)∫_{a-i∞}^{a+i∞} log ζ(s) x^s ds/s, with a > 1. Here f(x) = Σ_{p^n<x} 1/n.
- Differentiating in x gives (1/2πi)∫ log ζ(s) x^{s-1} ds. Formally this is df/dx, a sum of point masses of weight 1/n at the prime powers. The factor s appears written and then cancelled against the 1/s.
- He integrates against e^{-βx} x^{-t} over (1,∞). The exponent must be -t, as the second line x^{s-t-1} shows. The result is ∫_1^∞ e^{-βx} x^{-t} df(x).
- He equates this with Σ_p e^{-βp} p^{-t}.
- Interchanging the integrations gives (1/2πi)∫ log ζ(s) [∫_1^∞ e^{-βx} x^{s-t-1} dx] ds.
- My completion: the inner integral is β^{t-s} Γ(s-t, β), an upper incomplete gamma function.
- The fragment stops there. Its purpose is a contour-integral representation of an exponentially damped prime sum Σ e^{-βp} p^{-t}.

(B) ELLIPSOID (upper right and the whole lower half). This is Riemann's linear-flow model.
- Particle positions: x = l a0 + m b0 + n c0, and similarly for y, z, with coefficient matrix L = (l m n; l' m' n'; l'' m'' n'').
- Incompressibility: det L = abc = 1.
- The cofactors λ = m'n'' - n'm'', μ = n'l'' - l'n'', ν = l'm'' - l''m' (and primed analogues) form the inverse transpose of L.
- L is factored as L = A·diag(a,b,c)·B with A, B orthogonal; A = (α β γ; α' β' γ'; α'' β'' γ''). This is the singular-value / 'double rotation' decomposition. Equivalently:
  - L Lᵀ = A D² Aᵀ, so l²+m²+n² = a²α² + b²β² + c²γ² and ll'+mm'+nn' = a²αα' + b²ββ' + c²γγ';
  - the cofactor rows give λ''²+μ''²+ν''² = γ²/a² + γ'²/b² + γ''²/c²;
  - the second rotation is B = D⁻¹AᵀL, with entries (αl+α'l'+α''l'')/a, (βl+β'l'+β''l'')/b, (γl+γ'l'+γ''l'')/c, ...
- The quadratic forms on the page express the same facts: Σ(λx+λ'y+λ''z)² = ξ²/a² + η²/b² + ζ²/c², with ξ, η, ζ the coordinates along the principal axes.
- Normalisation at t = 0: L = diag(a,b,c), cofactor matrix = diag(1/a,1/b,1/c), A = B = I.
- Velocity gradient: u = Σ(∂l/∂t λ + ∂m/∂t μ + ∂n/∂t ν)x + ..., i.e. G = L' L⁻¹.
  - Its body-frame components are p, q, r; p', q', r'; p'', q'', r''.
  - At t = 0: p = (1/a)∂l/∂t, q = (1/b)∂m/∂t, p' = (1/a)∂l'/∂t, etc.
- Derivative of the inverse, d(L⁻¹) = -L⁻¹ L' L⁻¹, gives a∂λ/∂t = -p, b∂μ/∂t = -p', c∂ν/∂t = -p'', a∂λ'/∂t = -q, ...
  - Check on the diagonal: ∂λ/∂t = b∂n''/∂t + c∂m'/∂t = bc(q'+r'') = -p/a, using p+q'+r'' = 0 and abc = 1.
- A quantity ρ (definition only partly legible, involving the Gram entries ll'+mm'+nn' etc. and a parameter s) is differentiated: at t = 0, ∂ρ/∂t = (1 - a²/s²)(q''+r'). The ∂²ρ/∂t² line is left empty.

(B1) Angular velocity of the axes.
- Differentiate L Lᵀ = A D² Aᵀ at t = 0, with A' antisymmetric (∂α/∂t = 0, ∂α'/∂t + ∂β/∂t = 0).
- Diagonal: 2a ∂a/∂t = 2l ∂l/∂t, hence ∂a/∂t = ap (likewise ∂b/∂t = bq', ∂c/∂t = cr'').
- Off-diagonal: l∂l'/∂t + m'∂m/∂t = a²∂α'/∂t + b²∂β/∂t. Hence a²p' + b²q = (a²-b²)∂α'/∂t = (b²-a²)∂β/∂t, and cyclically with (a²p''+c²r)/(c²-a²) and (b²q''+c²r')/(c²-b²).
- Boxed special case a = b: then q = -p'.
- A first attempt via the inverse matrices (2λ∂λ'/∂t + ...) gives b²∂β/∂t + a²∂α'/∂t = -a²p' - b²q.

(B2) Equations of motion in the body frame.
- Write P = (body-frame gradient) as the rotated fixed-frame gradient (l1, m1, n1; l1', ...), so p = α(αl1+βm1+γn1) + β(...) + γ(...), etc.
- Differentiate at t = 0: ∂p/∂t = ∂l1/∂t + (rotation terms), e.g. m1∂β/∂t + n1∂γ/∂t + l1'(...) + l1''(...).
- From G' = L''L⁻¹ - G², using trace G = 0:
  - ∂l1/∂t = (1/a)∂²l/∂t² + p(q'+r'') - qp' - rp'';
  - ∂m1/∂t = (1/b)∂²m/∂t² + qr'' - rq''.
- Inserting the axis angular velocities from (B1) gives:
  - ∂p/∂t = (1/a)l_tt + p(q'+r'') - qp' - rp'' - (q+p')(a²p'+b²q)/(b²-a²) - (r+p'')(a²p''+c²r)/(c²-a²);
  - ∂q/∂t = (1/b)m_tt + qr'' - rq'' - (p-q')(a²p'+b²q)/(a²-b²) - r(b²q''+c²r')/(c²-b²) - q''(a²p''+c²r)/(c²-a²);
  - ∂p'/∂t = (1/a)l'_tt + p'r'' - r'p'' - (p-q')(a²p'+b²q)/(a²-b²) - r'(a²p''+c²r)/(c²-a²) - p''(b²q''+c²r')/(c²-b²).

(B3) Two conserved-type combinations (vorticity- and angular-momentum-like).
- q - p' = const and b²q - a²p' = const.
- Differentiating, with ∂a/∂t = ap and ∂b/∂t = bq':
  - ∂q/∂t - ∂p'/∂t = 0;
  - b²∂q/∂t - a²∂p'/∂t + 2b²qq' - 2a²pp' = 0.
- Solving: ∂q/∂t = 2a²pp'/(b²-a²) + 2b²qq'/(a²-b²).

(B4) Riemann's two angular velocities (the end of the page).
- Set w = ∂α'/∂t, the rotation rate of the A-frame. Set w1 = rotation rate of the B-frame, i.e. of the fluid relative to the axes.
- Then w = (a²p'+b²q)/(a²-b²) and w1 = ab(p'+q)/(a²-b²).
- Inverting: a p' = a w - b w1 and b q = a w1 - b w.
- Check equations: a²p' - b²q = (a²+b²)w - 2ab w1 and ab(p'-q) = 2ab w - (a²+b²)w1.
- Product: ab p'q = (a²+b²)w w1 - ab(w²+w1²).
- This is the decomposition used in the published 1861 memoir (Dedekind–Riemann double rotation).
errors: Number-theory fragment: the right-hand side should be Σ_{p,n} (1/n) e^{-βp^n} p^{-nt}, since d/dx of (1/2πi)∫ log ζ(s) x^s ds/s also charges prime powers. Writing only Σ e^{-βp} p^{-t} drops the prime-power terms. The x-derivative of the Perron integral is a distribution, so the interchange is purely formal.

The page writes (lx+l'y+l''z)²+... = a²(αx+βy+γz)² + b²(α'x+β'y+γ'z)². This is inconsistent with the adjacent lines x²+y²+z² = (αx+α'y+α''z)²+... and l²+m²+n² = a²α²+b²β²+c²γ². Consistency requires a²(αx+α'y+α''z)² + b²(βx+β'y+β''z)² + ... Either Riemann slipped or the transcription misreads it.

The inverse-matrix route line b²∂β/∂t + a²∂α'/∂t = -a²p' - b²q has a² and b² swapped relative to the convention of the following lines. With L Lᵀ = A D² Aᵀ the correct statement is b²∂α'/∂t + a²∂β/∂t = -(a²p'+b²q), which agrees with a²p'+b²q = (a²-b²)∂α'/∂t. That later line is correct, and the remaining derivation uses it.

The restated formula near the bottom, ∂q/∂t = ∂m1/∂t - (p-q')(...)/(a²-b²) + r(c²r'+b²q'')/(c²-b²) + q''(c²r+a²p'')/(c²-a²), has the opposite signs on the r and q'' terms. These conflict with the earlier full formula (with -r(...)/(c²-b²) and -q''(...)/(c²-a²)), which is the consistent one.

Minor: the expression for ∂λ/∂t should read m'∂n''/∂t + n''∂m'/∂t (at t = 0). In ∂p'/∂t the term should be p'r'' - r'p''; it appears as 'rp''' in the transcription. The first ∂m1/∂t line as transcribed, q(p+r''), does not equal the later, correct qr''.
The ρ computation cannot be verified because the definition of ρ (and of s) is only partly legible.

results.what: Contour-integral (Perron/Mellin) representation of an exponentially damped prime sum Σ e^{-βp} p^{-t} via log ζ(s), with the inner kernel an incomplete gamma function
results.modern_name: Mellin–Perron inversion with exponential smoothing (Cahen–Mellin type weighted prime sums)
results.usually_credited_to: Perron 1908, Cahen/Mellin 1890s; smoothed prime sums Σ Λ(n)e^{-n/x} systematically by Hardy–Littlewood 1916–18 (based on Riemann's 1859 formula)

results.what: Factorisation of the linear deformation matrix L = A·diag(a,b,c)·B with A, B orthogonal, and its use for an incompressible ellipsoid (abc = 1)
results.modern_name: Singular value decomposition / polar decomposition; Dedekind–Riemann ellipsoid kinematics
results.usually_credited_to: Dirichlet 1857/60, Dedekind 1860, Riemann 1861 (ellipsoid memoir); SVD in matrix theory Beltrami 1873 / Jordan 1874

results.what: Angular velocity of the principal axes from the velocity gradient: a²p'+b²q = (a²-b²)∂α'/∂t, and cyclic analogues
results.modern_name: Rate of rotation of the principal axes of the left Cauchy–Green tensor (spin of the Eulerian triad)
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann 1861 (ellipsoid memoir); later continuum mechanics (Hill, Truesdell)

results.what: Body-frame equations of motion for the velocity-gradient components p, q, p', ... including rotation terms
results.modern_name: Riemann's ellipsoid equations (virial/Lagrangian form, cf. Chandrasekhar's Ellipsoidal Figures of Equilibrium)

results.what: Conserved combinations q - p' and b²q - a²p' and the resulting ∂q/∂t = 2a²pp'/(b²-a²) + 2b²qq'/(a²-b²)
results.modern_name: Conservation of circulation (Kelvin/Helmholtz) and of angular momentum for Riemann ellipsoids

results.what: Decomposition into two angular velocities w, w1: a p' = a w - b w1, b q = a w1 - b w
results.modern_name: Ω (figure rotation) and internal vorticity Λ/ζ decomposition of Riemann–Dedekind ellipsoids

deep.surprise_reason: Almost everything on the page is preparatory computation for Riemann's published 1861 fluid-ellipsoid memoir (double-rotation decomposition, axis angular velocities, body-frame equations), all well known as his. The only mildly notable item is the two-line number-theory fragment. It writes an exponentially damped prime sum Σ e^{-βp}p^{-t} as a Perron-type integral of log ζ(s) against an incomplete-gamma kernel. This anticipates in form the smoothed prime sums later used by Hardy–Littlewood, but it is only a formal setup (it omits prime powers) with no result. Riemann's Nachlass is already known to contain number-theoretic analysis of this kind.

transcription_corrections: First line: the integrand is e^{-βx} x^{-t} (not x^{t}), as required by x^{s-t-1} in the second line. The factor written before x^{s-1} is the s cancelling the 1/s (it is struck), not '#x'.

'(lx+l'y+l''z)^2+... = a^2(αx+βy+γz)^2 + b^2(α'x+β'y+γ'z)^2' should be a^2(αx+α'y+α''z)^2 + b^2(βx+β'y+β''z)^2 + ..., consistent with x^2+y^2+z^2 = (αx+α'y+α''z)^2+... and l^2+m^2+n^2 = a^2α^2+b^2β^2+c^2γ^2. This is possibly Riemann's own slip.
'∂λ/∂t = n'∂m''/∂t + n''∂m'/∂t' is probably m'∂n''/∂t + n''∂m'/∂t (the t=0 value of the cofactor derivative).
'∂m1/∂t = (1/b)∂²m/∂t² + q(p+r'') ... - rq''': the consistent form, also used later on the page, is (1/b)∂²m/∂t² + qr'' - rq''.
'ν'^2+μ''^2+λ''^2' is presumably λ''^2+μ''^2+ν''^2 (third cofactor row), equal to γ^2/a^2+γ'^2/b^2+γ''^2/c^2.
'(αm+α'm'+α''m'')/b' should probably be divided by a (entry B_12 of B = D^{-1}AᵀL).
'b^2q - a^2p' = 2k''' and 'q - p' = c''' denote constants (conserved quantities). The labels are uncertain.
